name: ar_aging
title: Receivables aging by customer at 30 June 2026
purpose: Open invoices aged by days past due into buckets per customer (the bucket bounds and names are inputs), with invoice counts, the overdue share and the amount more than 90 days past due. The bucket is found with MATCH on the bucket bounds and INDEX on the bucket names instead of a ladder of nested IFs.
limitations: Template of the rule-of-thumb-model plugin: the open items are generated by make_data.py (seed 20261125).
Days past due = the as-of date minus the due date; a negative number means not yet due.
Bucket bounds and names are inputs: change them in model.spec.json and rebuild; the two lists pair by position and the bounds ascend.
Not due (0 or fewer days past due) and Over 90 days (more than the fixed cutoff of 90 days) read the days past due, not the buckets.

checks.label: Aging grid total equals the raw open amount
Invoice count grid total equals the raw row count
Past due % times total equals total less not-due amount (total not 0)
checks.note: Not due is read from the days past due (0 or fewer), not from the first bucket. A total of 0 gives 0 % (IFERROR in Past due %), so the actual side is 0. The expected side is then 0 less the not-due amount: 0 when no amount is open, not 0 (the check fails) when not-due and past-due amounts cancel out.

checks.label: Over-90 total equals the open amount more than 90 days past due
checks.note: Reads the helper columns open_k and days_past_due and the cutoff, not the column over90_k that the measure sums, and not the buckets.

notes.text: The nested-IF ladder IF(d<=0,"Not due",IF(d<=30,...)) is replaced by two helper columns: MATCH on the bucket bounds, then INDEX on the bucket names.
An invoice of a customer missing from the customer list drops out of the grids; the raw-total checks then fail.

Not due (0 or fewer days past due) and Over 90 days (more than the cutoff on the inputs sheet) read the days past due, not the buckets, so they keep their meaning when the bucket bounds and names change.
